summary: Computed L_C(p)=#{u>=1:(4uC-1)|(p+u)} (trial form of (★), FRONTIER §2.1) for all primes p≡1 (4), p≤10^6 (39175 primes), C=2^j, j=0..10 (scripts/z52d_p2_TO8_lev.c; analysis scripts/z52d_p2_TO8_z2911_an.py). Marginal level-failure rates rise 0.24 (C=1) to 0.999 (C=1024). Joint failure over j<k is 0.75–0.91× the independent product (all 11 levels: 1918 vs 2098 expected); adjacent-level phi ≈ −0.14 (C=1,2), −0.10, −0.07, but C=1 vs C=4 is +0.17. Same deficit for p>10^5 (fail j≤4: 1734 vs 1942 indep), so it is not a small-prime artefact; the effect is modest and the marginals are p-averaged, so no lottery-type conclusion is drawn.
not_done: Only p≤10^6 (spec was 10^8: cost ~100x per 10x p); no conditioning on the level-C residue of p beyond p mod 8; no comparison with a per-prime (p-conditioned) null model.
next: Rerun the joint test conditioned on R(p) size bins up to 3·10^6 in parallel if a finer lacunary-independence statement is wanted.

summary: The ternary closing step is already analysed: POINTWISE_TERNARY.md §1 (k=3, Duke–Schulze-Pillot primitive representations) and line 44 state that the ternary form Q_d = ef − 4da² (the Type II ternary reading) 'represents every integer, so it has no local or spinor content'; Prop 5.2 and Lemma 5.1 give the only usable indefinite case, which is conditional on (P). A sum-of-three-squares reading of the (★) certificate is not a ternary form in the certificate data (the certificate is a divisor pair of 4Cp+1, i.e. the split binary form xy; see METAPLECTIC_ES §1), so no DSP closing theorem is available for ES.
not_done: No data test of a sum-of-three-squares shape of 4Cp+1 = dd' (not run: the reading does not produce a ternary form in the certificate variables, so a test would have no defined target).
next: If a ternary representation of the certificate is wanted, the form must be chosen so that its spinor genus is non-trivial; that is the open part of POINTWISE_TERNARY §5.

summary: Writing D⁻_t(N)=#{d|N: d≡−1 (t)} as an indefinite coset theta series of xy is the definition itself, and METAPLECTIC_ES.md §1 (Thm K, K2) already gives R_t(n)=D⁻_t(N)−β_t(n) with Σ(D⁻−D⁺)(tn+1)qⁿ = Kronecker theta quotient θ(X²)/θ(X)² (line 72). The coset-theta-of-xy comparison therefore has no new content. The theta lift to a ternary/quaternary positive form is not in the repo as a computed object; I did not carry it out.
not_done: Theta lift of the xy coset series to a ternary/quaternary form (requires choosing the lattice and checking Siegel–Weil conditions; not started).
next: Pick a positive-definite target lattice whose theta lift to the xy coset is computed explicitly and compare coefficients with D⁻_t for t ≤ 64.

summary: Premise check passes: t=28, N=141=3·47 has divisors {1,3,19,1} mod 28, so D⁻_28(141)=0 (scripts/z52d_p2_TO8_z2935.py). Subset-product criterion (−1 reachable as a sub-multiset product of prime factors mod t) agrees with D⁻_t>0 in 3000/3000 random cases (N<1.28·10⁶, t≤64). For n≤2·10⁴ the failure density of F_t={n:D⁻_t(tn+1)=0} rises from 0.27 (t=3) to 0.95 (t=64); pairwise joint/indep ratios have median 1.0007 but reach 1.45 for (t,t')=(3,5). Seven n≤2·10⁴ (126, 3136, 3250, 5922, 6150, 6336, 9090) fail R_t(n)=0 for every t∈[3,64] (level t=2 rescues five of them; R_98(6150)=2 and R_364(9090)=1 are the first rescues in the t-ordering, scripts/z52d_p2_TO8_z2935b.py).
not_done: Density of the multiplicative description beyond the 3000-sample check; the rescue-level distribution was computed only for the 7 n≤2·10⁴ (not for n up to 10^6).
next: Compute the least rescue level t(n) for all n≤10^5 with t up to a few thousand, and test whether it grows with n (a level-rescue law for the words tuv−u−v).
